dates.event: Online Registration & Fee Payment Last Date

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) under the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registering on NATS, apply for the UCO Bank Apprenticeship Program on the NATS portal.
Candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC (info@bfsissc.com) inviting them to fill in detailed application information and make payment for the Online Examination at https://beep.bfsissc.com.
Pay the requisite non-refundable Application/Examination fee through ONLINE mode only from 14-10-2026 to 29-10-2026.
Appear for the Online Entrance Examination conducted by BFSI SSC on 07-11-2026 at 11 AM.
Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE State/UT only.
Keep the NATS Enrolment ID safe for all future correspondence.
No hard copy of application or documents is to be sent to the Bank’s office.

vacancyList.postName: Executive Trainee (Safety) – E-2 Grade (Post Code: HR/85)

howToApply: Visit the official NEEPCO website at https://neepco.co.in/ and navigate to the ‘Careers’ section.
Read the detailed advertisement and instructions carefully before filling the online application form.

General, EWS & OBC (NCL) category candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 560/- through SBI ePay favouring NEEPCO. SC, ESM category and female candidates are exempted from the fee.

Fill the online application form with accurate information including marks/percentage secured in graduation and experience details. The system will generate a Unique Registration/Application Number upon valid submission.

Keep scanned copies of the following documents ready for upload: (a) Matriculation/Secondary School Certificate as proof of date of birth, (b) Mark sheets and certificates for X, XII, and Graduation (Engineering), (c) Experience Certificate, (d) Caste Certificate (SC/OBC-NCL) in Government of India prescribed format (OBC-NCL certificate must be of current financial year), (e) Disability Certificate (if applicable), (f) Certificate of conversion of grades/CGPA to percentage (if percentage not distinctly mentioned), (g) Recent passport size colour photograph (JPEG, 20 KB–100 KB), (h) Signature (JPEG, 20 KB–100 KB).
Upload scanned copies of the above documents in the respective spaces provided in the online application form.
Submit the application and take a printout of the registration slip/form generated by the system for future reference.

Candidates employed with Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview and a relieving letter at the time of joining if selected.
